quotations.old_english: He ðæt scyldige werud forscrifen hefde
quotations.english: he had proscribed the guilty host

quotations.old_english: Grendel fífelcynnes eard weardode hwíle, siððan him Scyppend forscrifen hæfde
quotations.english: Grendel inhabited a while the monster-race's abode, after the Creator had proscribed him

definitions.meaning: to write or cut into, cut down

quotations.old_english: Awríteþ he on his wǽpne wællnota heáp, bealwe bócstafas bill forscrífeþ
quotations.english: he writes upon his weapon a heap of fatal marks, baleful letters he cuts into the bill

source_text: for-scrífan; p. -scráf, pl. -scrifon; pp. -scrifen [scrífan to judge], I. to condemn, proscribe; condemn&a-long;re, proscr&i-long;b&e-short;re :-- He ðæt scyldige werud forscrifen hefde he had proscribed the guilty host, Cd. 213 i Th. 267, 5; Sat. 33. Grendel fífelcynnes eard weardode hwíle, siððan him Scyppend forscrifen hæfde Grendel inhabited a while the monster-race's abode, after the Creator had proscribed him, Beo. Th. 213; B. 106. II. to write or cut into, cut down; inc&i-long;d&e-short;re, succ&i-long;d&e-short;re :-- Awríteþ he on his wǽpne wællnota heáp, bealwe bócstafas bill forscrífeþ he writes upon his weapon a heap of fatal marks, baleful letters he cuts into the bill, Salm. Kmbl. 323-326, note; Sal. 161, 162. Forscrif hine succ&i-long;de illam, Lk. Skt. Hat. 13, 7, 9. [Ger. ver-schreiben to prescribe.]
